replicated_originals.reference: Wulff, Ellis, Römer, Bardovi-Harlig & Leblanc (2009) The acquisition of tense-aspect: Converging evidence from corpora and telicity ratings

A.reason: Gries & Wulff (2009) on L2 constructions does not appear in the reference list or text; the only Gries works cited are the coll.analysis script and Gries & Stefanowitsch (2004).

B.reason: The abstract states 'The present study aims to replicate these findings' of [48] Wulff et al. (2009) that L1 corpus frequency and distinctiveness predict L2 tense-aspect production; the conclusion says Wulff et al.'s (2009) conclusion generalizes to L2 Spanish writing.

notes: Conceptual/extension replication: same predictors (L1 token frequency, distinctiveness via DCA) tested in L2 Spanish preterit-imperfect writing corpora (COWS-L2H, CEDEL2) rather than L2 English oral film retells. LAH/DPTH tests are hypothesis tests, not replications of a single original study.
